descripcion: Add `psutil` and document the required FFmpeg/ffprobe runtime dependency with reproducible version guidance in `pyproject.toml` and `README.md`

Add non-secret video-job settings for 100 MiB, 120 seconds, 1920×1080, 30 fps, 3600 frames, 300-second timeout, one worker, 60-minute result TTL, SQLite path and private video directory in `.env.example`
Extend ignored local-runtime patterns for the SQLite queue, staged videos, annotated MP4s and video benchmark output in `.gitignore`
Create deterministic MP4/H.264 fixture builders, fake ffprobe adapter, fake tracker and authorized principals in `tests/video_fixtures.py`
Create video-specific test packages and controlled E2E asset manifest under `tests/contract/`, `tests/integration/`, `tests/unit/`, `tests/performance/` and `tests/e2e/`

Add configuration tests for `MAX_VIDEO_UPLOAD_BYTES=104857600`, `MAX_VIDEO_DURATION_SECONDS=120`, `MAX_VIDEO_WIDTH=1920`, `MAX_VIDEO_HEIGHT=1080`, `MAX_VIDEO_FPS=30`, `MAX_VIDEO_FRAMES=3600`, `MAX_CONCURRENT_VIDEO_JOBS=1`, `VIDEO_JOB_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=300` and `VIDEO_RESULT_TTL_SECONDS=3600` in `tests/unit/test_video_config.py`
Add tests for legacy single-key and multi-key principals, constant-time comparison and no secret logging in `tests/unit/test_video_auth.py`

Add tests for `queued → processing → completed`, `queued → cancelled`, `queued → failed`, `processing → cancelled`, `processing → failed`, terminal immutability and restart recovery to `queued` in `tests/unit/test_video_job_store.py`
Extend typed settings with video limits, timeout, worker concurrency, SQLite/private paths, TTL and external FFmpeg executable configuration in `app/core/config.py`
Extend API-key handling to return a `Principal(key_id)` while mapping the existing single `API_KEY` to a default principal in `app/api/dependencies.py`
Add pre-upload API-key middleware that rejects `POST /api/v1/video-jobs` before multipart parsing or disk staging in `app/api/upload_auth.py` and register it in `app/main.py`
Define `VideoJob`, `VideoJobStatus`, `VideoMetadata`, `FrameDetection`, `VideoResult`, `VideoArtifact` and the exact state-transition guard in `app/domain/models.py`
Define typed public schemas for job acceptance, job status, safe errors, class summaries, temporary video and paginated detections in `app/domain/schemas.py`
Define a typed ffprobe/FFmpeg adapter protocol that exposes verified container, codec, size, duration, dimensions, fps and total frames in `app/adapters/video_probe.py`
Implement SQLite schema initialization, owner-filtered lookup, atomic dequeue/requeue, cleanup and pagination in `app/services/video_job_store.py`
Implement random private paths and cleanup for staged input and temporary annotated output in `app/services/video_artifacts.py`
Extend structured logging with `job_id`, `owner_key_id`, progress, per-frame timing, process memory and safe error code fields in `app/core/logging.py`
Initialize the video store, artifact manager and idle worker lifecycle, and atomically requeue non-expired interrupted jobs on startup in `app/core/lifespan.py`
Add OpenAPI contract tests for `POST /v1/video-jobs`, its `202`, `401`, `413`, `415`, `422` and `503` responses in `tests/contract/test_video_jobs_contract.py`

Add unit tests for streamed size limits and verified MP4/H.264 metadata including `duration_seconds <= 120`, `width <= 1920`, `height <= 1080`, `fps <= 30` and `total_frames <= 3600` in `tests/unit/test_video_validation.py`
Add integration tests proving valid upload returns a unique queued job in ≤2 s and invalid/corrupt videos create neither job nor staged artifact in `tests/integration/test_video_job_routes.py`

Add integration tests proving unauthenticated upload is rejected before multipart staging and interrupted non-expired queued work is recovered after restart in `tests/integration/test_video_job_recovery.py`
Implement streamed staging, FFmpeg/ffprobe verification and safe rejection for only MP4/H.264 videos within all configured limits in `app/services/video_validation.py`
Implement the job-creation service that stages only validated video, persists a UUID job owned by `Principal.key_id` and enqueues it atomically in `app/services/video_job_service.py`
Implement protected `POST /v1/video-jobs` with `202` response and public safe errors in `app/api/routes/video_jobs.py`
Register the video-job router and its documented OpenAPI metadata without changing existing image routes in `app/main.py`

Run the US1 contract, unit and integration tests from `tests/contract/test_video_jobs_contract.py`, `tests/unit/test_video_validation.py`, `tests/integration/test_video_job_routes.py` and `tests/integration/test_video_job_recovery.py`
Add OpenAPI contract tests for `GET`/`DELETE /v1/video-jobs/{jobId}` and paginated `GET /detections` in `tests/contract/test_video_jobs_contract.py`
Add unit tests for owner isolation, `page` from 1, `page_size` from 1 to 100, ordered `(frame_index, track_id)` results and terminal cancellation conflict in `tests/unit/test_video_job_store.py`
Add integration tests for progress, other-principal invisibility, queued/processing cancellation, terminal conflict, result-not-ready and expired jobs in `tests/integration/test_video_job_routes.py`
Add artifact-access tests for same-principal retrieval, invalid credentials, cancelled output absence and 60-minute TTL behavior in `tests/integration/test_video_artifact_access.py`
Implement owner-filtered status lookup, public progress projection, ordered detection pagination and terminal-state conflict rules in `app/services/video_job_store.py`
Implement cooperative cancellation request, cancellation cleanup and expiration cleanup in `app/services/video_job_service.py` and `app/services/video_artifacts.py`
Implement protected status, cancellation and paginated-detection endpoints with `404`, `409` and `410` safe responses in `app/api/routes/video_jobs.py`
Implement protected annotated-video retrieval using owner-scoped temporary artifacts in `app/api/routes/video_jobs.py`

Run the US2 contract, unit and integration tests from `tests/contract/test_video_jobs_contract.py`, `tests/unit/test_video_job_store.py`, `tests/integration/test_video_job_routes.py` and `tests/integration/test_video_artifact_access.py`
Add unit tests for resetting ByteTrack between jobs and preserving positive `track_id` values for consecutive visible frames in `tests/unit/test_video_processing.py`
Add unit tests for frame-bounds normalization, class summaries, MP4 annotation output and no partial publication after timeout/cancellation in `tests/unit/test_video_processing.py`
Add integration E2E test for a controlled video with stable track IDs, paginated detections, coherent summary and retrievable annotated MP4 in `tests/integration/test_video_job_routes.py`
Add contract assertions for completed `VideoJobResponse`, `FrameDetection`, `DetectionPage` and temporary video schemas in `tests/contract/test_video_jobs_contract.py`
Implement a shared YOLOv10s ByteTrack adapter that resets per job, reuses the loaded model and maps frame outputs to normalized detections in `app/adapters/yolov10_tracker.py`

Implement frame decoding, timeout/cancellation checkpoints, per-frame inference/annotation, ByteTrack persistence, SQLite detections, class summaries and FFmpeg MP4 output in `app/services/video_processing.py`

Implement the bounded worker loop that atomically dequeues jobs, processes one job with the configured timeout, records failure/cancellation and never publishes partial output in `app/services/video_worker.py`
Integrate the worker with shared model state, artifacts and job-store lifecycle in `app/core/lifespan.py`
Expose completed summaries, paginated detections and temporary annotated-video URLs from the public job projections in `app/api/routes/video_jobs.py`
Run the US3 unit, contract and integration tests from `tests/unit/test_video_processing.py`, `tests/contract/test_video_jobs_contract.py` and `tests/integration/test_video_job_routes.py`
Add FFmpeg/ffprobe availability and version checks to startup readiness without exposing executable paths in `app/core/lifespan.py` and `app/api/routes/health.py`

Add structured job/frame metrics for upload, validation, inference, annotation, output, memory, errors, model version, ByteTrack, FFmpeg and non-secret configuration in `app/core/logging.py` and `tests/unit/test_video_worker.py`

Add a 20-video reference benchmark that persists non-secret p95, hardware, model, ByteTrack, FFmpeg, memory, error and per-frame timing evidence in `tests/performance/test_video_reference_benchmark.py`
Add controlled E2E regression coverage for the existing image flow plus the new video flow in `tests/e2e/test_image_and_video_regression.py`

Perform security review for pre-upload authorization, owner isolation, SQLite/file permissions, TTL cleanup, safe error bodies and no sensitive logging in `specs/002-procesamiento-video-vial/security-review.md`
Update video settings, FFmpeg installation requirement, API examples, artifact retention, supported scope and run instructions in `README.md` and `.env.example`
Run the complete suite, execute every scenario in `specs/002-procesamiento-video-vial/quickstart.md`, record coverage and benchmark evidence in `specs/002-procesamiento-video-vial/quickstart.md`
Review FR-001 through FR-014 and SC-001 through SC-006 against code and evidence, then record final traceability in `specs/002-procesamiento-video-vial/coverage.md`
